title: 第20章 许川第21章 挂靠
content_zh:
其实早在下午的时候，他们就猜到陆沉突破明劲了。
毕竟陆沉可是扛着一头黑鳞狼回来的，虽然那黑鳞狼内脏被掏空，但仍然还有一百七十多斤，如果没有突破明劲那根本不可能从大寒山扛回来。
所以哪怕这头黑鳞狼不是陆沉杀的，也能证明陆沉的实力了。
此时听陆沉亲口承认，陆家众人彼此对视一眼，一个个都无比的激动。
“好样的。”
陆老爷子难掩兴奋，却又有些欲言又止。
他想不到自己最看好的陆青河没有突破，反倒是陆沉一跃成为了明劲武人。
于是陆老爷子了片刻，然后下定决心回到内屋，从主屋拿出一个包裹交给陆沉。
“拿着！”
陆沉打开包裹，发现里面放着三十多两银子。
这让陆沉愣了一下，只听陆老爷子道：“这是我们家多年积累下来的，原本是准备留着给青河叩关明劲的时候用。”
“既然你已经突破了，那往后家里自然要全力扶持你。”
陆沉闻言，对陆老头的不满不由消散了一些。
虽然当初这陆老头不愿扶持他学武，但到底是站在整个家族的的利益考虑，而且这些时日为了给家里节省钱财，确实已经把旱烟给戒了。
不过陆沉没有接这笔银子，而是将其递回去道：“我已突破明劲，想要更进一步不是几十两银子能做到的。”
“这笔钱还是留给清河弟吧。”
说到这里，陆沉又询问道：“大伯怎么不在？”
在场众人闻言，不由露出一抹苦涩。
陆恒阳欲言又止，还是说道：“这次春狩，你大伯断了一条手臂，现在还在里屋躺着。”
陆沉闻言，不由眉心微皱。

他来到里屋，只见陆磐石虚弱的躺在床上，一条手臂似乎已经被某种野兽扯断了。
“如果不是为了保护我，大伯也不会……”
陆青河哽咽开口，泪流满面。
陆沉没有回答，只是开口问道：“郎中怎么说？”
“保住了性命，只是以后这条手臂怕是废了。”
陆老头叹息，眼中泛起一丝悲哀：“王家送了十两银子过来，外加两瓶金疮药，但是把他的护院之职给辞了。”
陆沉闻言，眉心微皱。
十两银子买一条手臂，跟打发要饭的也没太大区别了。
而且陆磐石废了，陆家少了一个顶梁柱，以后的进项怕是会少一大截。
陆元鸿知道他想什么，当即叮嘱道：“我们在王家眼里只是泥腿子而已，若非陆青河还在那里当护院，这是十两银子都未必能到手上。”
“你虽然已经突破明劲，但是王家毕竟家大业大，千万不要上门讨要说法。”
陆沉点头，拿出十两银子给陆玄轲道：“这些钱拿去买药，先给大伯养好伤再说。”
“沉弟……”
陆玄轲拿过银钱，竟然哽咽的跪倒。
对此陆沉只是将他扶起，拍了拍他的肩膀道：“大伯受伤，以后你就是大房的顶梁柱，要快点振作起来。”
……
处理好此事，陆沉独自回到了屋里，不由开始沉思起来。
content_en:
In fact, as early as the afternoon, they had guessed that Lu Chen had broken through Ming Jin.
After all, Lu Chen came back carrying a black-scaled wolf. Although the internal organs of the black-scaled wolf were eviscerated, it still weighed more than 170 kilograms. If he had not broken through Ming Jin, it would have been impossible to carry it back from the Dahan Mountain.
So even if Lu Chen didn't kill this black-scaled wolf, it still proves Lu Chen's strength.
At this time, hearing Lu Chen admit it personally, everyone in the Lu family looked at each other, and everyone was extremely excited.
"Well done."
Mr. Lu couldn't hide his excitement, but he was hesitant to speak.
He didn't expect that Lu Qinghe, whom he was most optimistic about, did not make a breakthrough, but Lu Chen suddenly became a Ming Jin martial artist.
So Mr. Lu thought for a moment, then made up his mind to go back to the inner room, took out a package from the main room and handed it to Lu Chen.
"Take it!"
Lu Chen opened the package and found more than thirty taels of silver inside.
This made Lu Chen stunned for a moment, and then he heard Mr. Lu say: "This is what our family has accumulated over the years. It was originally intended to be used by Qinghe when he knocked on Guan Mingjin."
"Now that you have made a breakthrough, your family will naturally support you with all their strength in the future."
When Lu Chen heard this, his dissatisfaction with Old Man Lu dissipated a little.
Although Old Man Lu was unwilling to support him in learning martial arts at the beginning, he did it for the interests of the entire family, and in order to save money for the family these days, he had indeed given up smoking.
However, Lu Chen did not accept the money. Instead, he handed it back and said, "I have broken through Ming Jin. Going one step further cannot be achieved with dozens of taels of silver."
"Let's leave this money to Brother Qinghe."
Speaking of this, Lu Chen asked again: "Why isn't uncle here?"
When everyone present heard this, they couldn't help but show a hint of bitterness.
Lu Hengyang hesitated to speak, and finally said: "This spring hunting, your uncle broke an arm, and he is still lying in the back room."
Lu Chen couldn't help but frown slightly when he heard this.
When he came to the back room, he saw Lu Panshi lying weakly on the bed, one of his arms seemed to have been torn off by some kind of wild beast.
"If it wasn't for protecting me, my uncle wouldn't..."
Lu Qinghe choked up and burst into tears.
Lu Chen didn't answer, but just asked: "What did the doctor say?"
"My life was saved, but I'm afraid this arm will be useless in the future."
Old Man Lu sighed, with a trace of sadness in his eyes: "The Wang family sent him ten taels of silver, plus two bottles of gold sore medicine, but they resigned from his position as guardian."
Lu Chen frowned slightly when he heard this.
Buying an arm for ten taels of silver is not much different from sending someone away to beg for food.
Moreover, with Lu Panshi dead, the Lu family has lost a pillar, and their future income may be greatly reduced.
Lu Yuanhong knew what he was thinking, and immediately warned: "In the eyes of the Wang family, we are just mud-legged people. If Lu Qinghe were not still there as a nurse, we might not be able to get even ten taels of silver."
"Although you have broken through Ming Jin, the Wang family is a big family after all. You must not come to ask for an explanation."
Lu Chen nodded, took out ten taels of silver and gave it to Lu Xuanke and said, "Use this money to buy medicine. Let uncle recover from his injuries first."
"Brother Shen..."
Lu Xuanke took the money and fell to his knees with sobs.
In response, Lu Chen just helped him up, patted his shoulder and said, "Uncle is injured. From now on, you will be the pillar of the house. You must cheer up quickly."
…
After handling the matter, Lu Chen returned to the room alone and began to think deeply.
